blocks.text: East Chilliwack: Rural Homes and Agricultural Land

parts.t: East Chilliwack is defined by agricultural land, rural properties, and mountain backdrops more than by suburban shopping strips. Buyers looking here typically want acreages, farm-adjacent homes, or quieter valley properties with space — not a Luckakuck Way / Vedder-corridor suburban lifestyle.

Outdoor recreation across the eastern Fraser Valley is close, while Highway 1 still makes Abbotsford and the wider valley reachable. Compare East Chilliwack with other Chilliwack districts when you want rural character and land; ask for current acreage and rural home listings for this side of Chilliwack.
Written by
Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®

— Royal LePage Little Oak Realty · Licensed in the Fraser Valley since 2015 · Top 1% of Fraser Valley REALTORS® · #8 of 5,061 FVREB REALTORS® · Top 10 Royal LePage in BC · Top 35 Under 35 · Diamond and Hall of Fame awards · $500M+ in career sales · 5.0 client rating across 95 Google reviews. blocks.text: Buying a Home in East Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: East Chilliwack

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Chilliwack Central Road, Prest Road, Ford Road, McGuire Road, Gibson Road, and Highway 1 Exit 123 (Prest Road) and Exit 129 (Annis Road). Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in East Chilliwack will find rural detached houses on half-acre to multi-acre lots, hobby farms, equestrian properties, and commercial dairy, poultry, nursery, and forage farms in the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR). For a full breakdown of official community plans, catchment maps, and hazard overlays, read our
East Chilliwack Neighbourhood Guide

blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in East Chilliwack

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in East Chilliwack are served by East Chilliwack Elementary (K–5 at 49190 Chilliwack Central Road), Little Mountain Elementary, and Chilliwack Middle / Chilliwack Secondary in SD33 (plus SD33's new east-side elementary opening September 2027). Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include nearby Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park, Gwynne Vaughan Park, Mount Thom and Elk Mountain trailheads, and scenic country cycling routes across the eastern valley floor. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by nearby BC Transit routes at Prest Road and Broadway (Route 57) and fast commuter access onto Highway 1 at Exit 123 (Prest Road).

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in East Chilliwack

parts.t: Land use and building permits in East Chilliwack are regulated by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, the City's Agricultural Area Plan, Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) principal and secondary residence floor-area rules, and Fraser River floodplain bylaws. Before removing subjects on a property in East Chilliwack, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

and

What types of homes are for sale in East Chilliwack?

Active MLS® listings in East Chilliwack typically include rural detached houses on half-acre to multi-acre lots, hobby farms, equestrian properties, and commercial dairy, poultry, nursery, and forage farms in the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR). All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve East Chilliwack in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near East Chilliwack include East Chilliwack Elementary (K–5 at 49190 Chilliwack Central Road), Little Mountain Elementary, and Chilliwack Middle / Chilliwack Secondary in SD33 (plus SD33's new east-side elementary opening September 2027). Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near East Chilliwack?

Residents of East Chilliwack have access to nearby Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park, Gwynne Vaughan Park, Mount Thom and Elk Mountain trailheads, and scenic country cycling routes across the eastern valley floor. See our
East Chilliwack Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in East Chilliwack?

Key road corridors serving East Chilliwack include Chilliwack Central Road, Prest Road, Ford Road, McGuire Road, Gibson Road, and Highway 1 Exit 123 (Prest Road) and Exit 129 (Annis Road). Public transit connections include nearby BC Transit routes at Prest Road and Broadway (Route 57) and fast commuter access onto Highway 1 at Exit 123 (Prest Road).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in East Chilliwack?

Properties in East Chilliwack are governed by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, the City's Agricultural Area Plan, Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) principal and secondary residence floor-area rules, and Fraser River floodplain bylaws. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in East Chilliwack freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in East Chilliwack are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
